# Expression parser (course-provided)

`include/expression.h` and the prebuilt `libexpression_parser.a` libraries were provided by
FIT ČVUT (Czech Technical University in Prague) as part of the course assignment. They parse
cell expressions and report them to a `CExprBuilder` implementation (see `src/myBuilder.*`).

- `lib/arm64-darwin23-clang/`: macOS arm64, Clang
- `lib/arm64-darwin23-g++/`: macOS arm64, GCC

These files are **not** covered by the repository's MIT license.
